records.scope: Entire 750-line javap display, including private real-object count and toString.
records.observation: Output constructor creates shadow HashMap and two lists, initial final-time order; input constructor leaves map/lists null until reading, initial start-time order. Base size is 42. add keys shadows by a List of topology followed by vertex line IDs; first entry uses topology shadow definition and marks it used, later entries merge primitive with size subtraction/addition. No buffer time-bound update in add/merge. mergeWith copies missing Shadow values but reuses keys, merges existing values and adjusts size. Category weight initialization/finalization delegate to each Shadow; summarize passes buffer duration. Counts expose shadow group count, while private real-object count sums Shadow long counts. Identity map reads output map. Nestable iterator boolean is unused. writeObject appends map values to state/nonstate lists without clearing, orders by start time only when comparator changes, writes base plus two counts and shadows, then marks saved. Repeated writes without empty append duplicates; empty only clears when saved, resets order/size but not inherited bounds. readObject replaces lists and ignores resolveCategory return, but does not reset accumulated byte size or comparator; initial input map stays null. toString uses output map or input overlap iterators. These are local method behaviors, not proof that normal callers violate lifecycle requirements; Shadow internals remain unread. Archived application not executed.
